message.content: In the conversations provided, there isn't a direct suggestion from Li Hua regarding the frequency of bread deliveries. However, it seems that Li Hua is open to receiving bread more frequently. Initially, she proposes that Hailey Johnson sends her bread twice a week, specifically mentioning Monday at 8 am and Friday at 8 am. Later, when discussing the possibility of a new gluten-free bread option, Li Hua expresses interest in having it available for delivery starting the following week. This indicates that Li Hua is eager to receive fresh bread regularly. Li Hua also mentions that she has a regular delivery service with Alice, which occurs every Monday and Friday at 8 am. Therefore, it appears that Li Hua prefers a consistent delivery schedule rather than a less frequent one.
